prompt: What was the name of the play in which entertainer/artist/actor Charles Marchand (1890-1930) made his first public appearance in Ottawa in 1910?
answer: Charles Marchand made his first public appearance in Ottawa in 1910 in **_Fleur d’ajonc_**, a play by Théodore Botrel.
